jobs.sum: مطلوب طالب عمل في هندسة الإلكترونيات للمشاركة في تصميم وتحليل واختبار الإلكترونيات لأنظمة الطائرات بدون طيار. العمل يدعم فريق التطوير في حل المشكلات وتحسين المكونات الإلكترونية.
jobs.txt:
Company: Quantum-Systems GmbH
Title: Working Student Electronics Engineering (m/f/d)
Location: Gilching, Bayern, Germany
Visa: 
Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. As a Working Student Electronics Engineering, you will be a key part of our Electronics Team, supporting the design, analysis, testing and troubleshooting of electronics for our products. Together with our World-Class-Team, currently 15 team members, you will take part on pushing the boundaries of drone technologies. You will be working closely with different development and product teams to clarify requirements, resolve blockers and speed up iterations. Helping us delivery reliable electronics solutions is how you will have a meaningful impact at Quantum-Systems. What is your Day to Day Mission: Support electronics design, analysis, testing, debugging and documentation Work with other tea
